name: Website Buying & Flipping

yield.notes: Buy undervalued sites on Flippa/Empire Flippers, improve and sell at higher multiple. Income from interim cash flow + sale.

flags: Google penalty risk on acquired sites
Overpaying for sites with overstated revenue
Content may need significant investment to grow

startup_checklist: Learn due diligence basics: verify traffic in GA/GSC, revenue in Stripe/PayPal, backlink profile
Start with small purchases ($500-2,000) on Flippa to learn the process
Focus on sites with traffic but undermonetized (easy upside)
Implement quick wins: better ad placement, affiliate swap, email list capture
List for sale at 30-40x monthly profit after 6-12 months of improvement
failure_modes: Google update tanks traffic after purchase
Revenue was overstated in seller data
Site takes longer to improve than expected
kill_criteria: Traffic drops >50% in first 90 days post-acquisition
Site generating zero revenue after 6 months of effort
sources_note: Multiple data from Empire Flippers marketplace listings.
